title: In vivo passive trunk load-relaxation: initial moment and 16-min moment drop at 30-100% of flexion-relaxation angle (standing frame, pelvis rotated)
condition: passive (EMG biofeedback to minimise activation); static flexion held 16 min

quantity.name: passive extension moment about L5/S1 during load-relaxation
quantity.definition: moment = load-cell force on the T8 harness rod x vertical distance from rod to L5/S1 centre of rotation; initial moment = mean of first 3 s, moment drop = initial - mean of last 3 s of the 16-min hold; lumbar flexion from IMUs, targets as % of each subject's FR angle; NZ = range around upright where slope < 0.1 Nm/deg and moment < 7 Nm, normalised by FR angle

source.authors: Toosizadeh N, Nussbaum MA, Bazrgari B, Madigan ML
source.sample: 10 healthy young adults without LBP (5 M: 24.4 (4.2) y, 179.9 (6.9) cm, 71 (7.3) kg; 5 F: 23.8 (2.6) y, 164.4 (3.9) cm, 57.9 (5.1) kg); flexion-relaxation (FR) angle 58.2 (12.0) deg after creep

protocol.summary: Participant stands in a rigid frame, pelvis restrained; trunk held roughly upright by a harness-rod at T8; lumbar flexion induced by rotating pelvis and lower limbs together forward/upward at ~3 deg/s about an axis aligned with L5/S1 (footrest height adjusted), held 16 min at 30, 40, 60, 80 or 100% FR angle (one level per session, randomised), then returned. EMG of longissimus and rectus abdominis used as biofeedback. Sessions before 9:00. FR angle measured after creep (full passive flexion).
how_to_simulate: Model upright trunk with thorax (T8) fixed and pelvis rotated about the L5/S1 axis to impose lumbar flexion (no gravity moment needed beyond the paper's net measurement; model should output the moment at the T8 constraint transferred to L5/S1)
Set muscle activations to zero; impose lumbar flexion of 30-100% of the model's FR angle (~58 deg mean) at 3 deg/s
Report the passive moment about L5/S1 at the start of the hold (compare with initial moment); for viscoelastic models also hold 16 min and compare the moment drop

subject_model.source: Methods (mean of male and female group means; derived)

protocol.notes: Incomplete data for 4 trials at 30% FR and 1 outlier excluded at 100% FR (n slightly < 10 there). Best-fit curves from the paper: initial moment = 13.99 exp(0.0158 x) - 13.31 (R2 0.99); moment drop = 3.11 exp(0.0212 x) - 1.871 (R2 0.93); NZ change = 38.88 exp(0.0067 x) - 37.29 (x = % FR). Viscoelastic model parameters (Table 1, Fig 6) not extracted. Watt 2022 reviewed this study (standing) but did not use it in the quantitative synthesis.

extraction.from: Fig 4a-c (p.5; mean + SD), text p.2 and p.5
extraction.uncertainty: initial moment +-0.5 Nm, moment drop +-0.3 Nm, NZ change +-0.5 %; SD (cap) +-0.5 units (pixel analysis at 300 dpi: 6.4, 10.1 and 6.6 px per unit)
extraction.check_notes: Dot centres located from dark-run midpoints in columns +-6 px from each x tick and whisker caps by following the error line upward; values agree with the printed exponential fits (e.g. fit at 100% FR: 13.99e^1.58-13.31 = 54.5 vs 51.8 digitised; at 60%: 22.8 vs 22.7) and with the visual reading of the figure.
